answer: Resist sybils by pricing, not detection. Each epoch the protocol auctions exactly N seats — each a minted pearl, the only vote its consensus pulse accepts — in a batch auction with escrowed, burned bids. An ocean of accounts gains nothing: N seats clear at the market price however many identities bid, so k accounts pay the same total as one for the same seats, plus bid fees and escrow. The scarce budget — N seats, escrow — is enforced by consensus code, not clone detection. Wealth still buys seats; the cap kills fake identities, not capital.
